name: Truncated Tensor Decomposition
aliases: Truncated Tensor Decomposition — Low-Rank Approximation via Truncation, Rank Truncation, Rank-reduced tensor decomposition
definition: A rank-reduced approximation where the multilinear rank $(R_1, R_2, ..., R_N)$ is explicitly chosen to be smaller than the initial ranks $(I_1, I_2, ..., I_N)$ to achieve compression.
summary: Truncated Tensor Decomposition is a post-processing technique that reduces the multilinear rank of an existing Tucker decomposition to achieve data compression or interactive level-of-detail without recomputing the full decomposition.
